Description: Shannon's Sandbox is a high-precision web toolkit for exploring Information Theory and Digital Communications, bridging the gap between mathematical theory and practical application. Built with a Python (Flask) backend and an interactive HTML/JS frontend, it features extreme decimal precision (50 places) to handle complex calculations like Entropy H(X), Joint Entropy, and Shannon's Chain Rule. The platform allows users to simulate BPSK and Binary Symmetric Channels, while comparing lossless compression algorithms—including Huffman, Shannon-Fano, and Adaptive Arithmetic Coding—against the theoretical Shannon limit.

ZewailHub is a comprehensive academic advising portal designed to digitize the undergraduate experience at Zewail City. It serves as a central hub for students to manage course enrollments, track GPA and transcripts, and communicate with academic advisors. The platform features a robust course catalog with prerequisite tracking, integrated course resources (PDFs, videos), and a modern UI complete with Rive and Lottie animations. Built for scalability, it utilizes a detailed relational schema to manage majors, minors, and departmental data.
Tech Stack: ASP.NET Core 8, C#, SQL Server, Razor Pages, Rive, Lottie

Description: A classic arcade-style Brick Breaker game developed in C++ using the CMUgraphicsLib library. The project features a robust Object-Oriented Architecture (OOP) with distinct Design and Play modes. Users can build custom levels with various brick types—including normal, hard, and unbreakable rocks—and save or load their layouts via Excel-based integration. Gameplay is enhanced through a system of dynamic collectables, featuring power-ups like FireBall and MultipleBalls, and challenging power-downs like ReverseDirection and ShrinkPaddle.

A high-fidelity Operating Systems simulator built in C to model process scheduling and memory management. It features a Buddy System for dynamic memory allocation (up to 1024 bytes) and supports multiple scheduling algorithms including Shortest Job First (SJF), Round Robin (RR), and Pre-emptive Highest Priority First (PHPF). The system leverages Linux IPC mechanisms—Message Queues, Shared Memory, and Signals—to synchronize a Process Generator, a System Clock, and the Scheduler. It generates automated performance logs (scheduler.log, mem.log) to analyze CPU utilization, turnaround time, and waiting time.
Tech Stack: C, Linux IPC (Signals, Shared Memory), Makefile

Description: A lightweight and versatile PDF management tool designed for seamless document viewing and editing. Developed with a Python-based GUI, it enables users to read PDFs, manage recent files, and perform complex operations such as merging multiple documents or splitting files by page ranges. The application features a robust conversion engine to transform PDFs into Word, PowerPoint, and image formats (PNG/JPEG), alongside utility functions for rotating and extracting specific pages. It includes a comprehensive set of keyboard shortcuts to optimize user workflow and productivity.

A specialized suite of Python-based security and media tools designed for the decryption and archival of DRM-protected content from platforms like BunnyCDN, VDOCipher, and Sprout. The toolkit automates the complex process of manifest parsing, Widevine license fetching (via pywidevine), and media muxing. It includes a multi-platform interface, featuring a command-line CLI for power users and an interactive Telegram bot for automated, mobile-friendly media delivery.

An advanced two-stage AI pipeline for exoplanet discovery that filters raw light curve data from NASA's Kepler, K2, and TESS missions. Stage 1 utilizes unsupervised anomaly detection to isolate unusual signals from noise, while Stage 2 employs a deep learning classifier to identify legitimate exoplanet signatures. The platform features an immersive 3D space-themed UI with interactive model hyperparameter tuning, detailed feature-level prediction explanations, and seamless integration with Hugging Face-hosted specialized models.
Tech Stack: HTML5, JavaScript (ESM), Spline 3D, Gradio API, CSS3

Description: An automated bug reporting and ticketing system for the ZC Toolbox platform. This Telegram bot allows users to submit structured bug reports (categorized by features like GPA or Planner) and query the status of open tickets in real-time. It features a graph-based backend using Neo4j Aura to map relationships between users and reported issues, ensuring efficient data tracking and retrieval through an interactive chat interface.
Tech Stack: Python, Neo4j Aura (Cypher), Telegram Bot API, python-dotenv

Description: A specialized browser extension engineered to enhance the academic workflow for Zewail City students. It features a suite of productivity tools including a Cumulative GPA calculator, a granular coursework progress tracker, and a long-term academic planner. Additionally, the extension includes a custom script to bypass "Stop List" grade blocking on the Student Information System (SIS), streamlining access to academic records and improving the overall user experience.
